title: Scantling rule table (RuleTable)
description: A yard's own class-society minimum-thickness rules, applied by tpt-yard-hydrostatics (RuleTable::from_json_str). The engine ships no class values: each rule is t_min = base_mm + coeff_mm * L^length_exponent, clamped to [min_mm, max_mm], in the ship length L (m).

society.description: Society name, free text for reports.

edition.description: Edition label, free text for reports.

basis.description: Net: the corrosion addition is added on top. Gross: as built.
